Trellis blocks another start when it cannot prove the previous agent stopped. The [check](/Users/navidkhan/projects/trellis/apps/server/src/services/sessions/start.ts:51) requires a runtime record or saved evidence of exit.

I confirmed four affected sessions: `linux`, `principal`, `Principal`, and `prod`. Their conversation IDs remain, but both forms of exit evidence are missing. Runtime cleanup can delete that evidence before the host saves it. Those four remain blocked.

The original list-load bug is fixed and installed as `c618c37bf`. Agents and Sessions load again. All 14 tests, lint, and type checks pass. The restart preserved the runtime and all 36 session identities.
